name: Brisbane's 20 in 20 in 2020
information: It's 2020, which only means one thing: time for a NON-STOP 20 HOUR COMPETITION with exactly 20 ROUNDS. Yes, we're a bit crazy, but it's going to be awesome. Note that the main events will occur during the middle of the 20 hours, such that most competitors should only need to be present during the more regular hours of the day. For more informations, please look at the [FAQ page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#13966-faq) and [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Brisbanes20in20in2020#competition-schedule). ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
